Body.Content:
Quality evaluation plans can now run automatically when a support case is resolved. This helps organizations evaluate customer interactions at the right point in the service lifecycle, without relying only on scheduled or manual review processes. By triggering evaluations from the case resolution event, teams can reduce unnecessary re-evaluation, save review effort, and generate timely quality insights for resolved cases.

GA date: October CY2026
